welcome.headline_1: Stop treating your skin like a chore.

problem.headline_1: Stop treating skincare like a chore.
problem.body: You focus on your career, travels, and life. meanwhile., our intelligent system manages your skin's biological capital in the background.
problem.philosophy_title: Your skin is a living, breathing asset.
problem.philosophy_body: It reacts to glucose spikes, cortisol from stress, sleep quality, and the environment. Managing this manually is a full-time job you don't have time for.
problem.modal_outro: We take the cognitive load. You get the results.

pregnancy.subtitle_trim: This helps m.i. calibrate your protocols and ingredient safety filters.
pregnancy.trim_1_detail: Focus: hydration, nausea-friendly textures, barrier support
pregnancy.trim_3_detail: Focus: stretch marks, deep hydration, calming protocols
pregnancy.filter_desc: Retinol, salicylic acid, hydroquinone, and other pregnancy-unsafe actives will be flagged in scans and excluded from routines.
pregnancy.adapt_desc: Your routine evolves as your body changes — from first trimester nausea-friendly protocols to third trimester stretch-mark prevention.
pregnancy.alert_desc: When scanning any product — yours or from a shelf — m.i. will warn about ingredients contraindicated during pregnancy.

push.title: Let m.i. manage in the background.
push.body: You focus on your day. meanwhile., our intelligent notifications keep your skin portfolio optimized—deploying the right protocol at the right time, so you never have to think about it.

integrations.title: Let's connect with your life.
integrations.body: meanwhile. becomes truly intelligent when it understands your lifestyle. Grant us permission to view your Google Calendar, and we can provide proactive advice for events like flights, late nights, or stressful meetings.

wise_bloom.title_1: Your focus is resilience and density.
wise_bloom.body_1: Since your skin no longer has a monthly cycle, we implement a 7-day Cellular Training Rhythm. We alternate between Restoration (The Constants) and Stimulation (The Shifts) to keep your skin cells in peak performance.
wise_bloom.bullet_2: Loss of density and firmness → structural rebuilding
wise_bloom.intro_2: Your complete management framework, re-imagined into a powerful weekly rhythm:
wise_bloom.constants_desc: Your Index Fund — daily foundation for barrier support and constant nourishment.
wise_bloom.shifts_desc: Dynamic Assets — the heart of your 7-day training rhythm. Targeted 'exercises' for your skin cells on different days.
wise_bloom.assets_desc: High-Yield Interventions — specialized tools for targeting specific concerns and boosting your weekly results.
wise_bloom.closing: Your rhythm is a weekly pulse—and your skin stays in peak performance.
